{{Quote|Sir, our cannon at the base of the tower has been destroyed!|The Muun to [[San Hill/Legends|San Hill]] during the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]]|<ref name="Chapter 4">{{CW|4}}</ref>}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''unidentified [[Muun/Legends|Muun]]''' was a member of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the [[Battle of Muunilinst/Legends|Battle of Muunilinst]], this Muun was among the Banking Clan leadership that oversaw the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces on the ground via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]]. The Muun alerted [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[San Hill/Legends|San Hill]] that the cannon at the base of the command tower had been destroyed. Not long after, the [[The Muunilinst 10|Muunilinst 10]] was able to infiltrate the Banking Clan's command center and force the leaders to surrender.
